name: Valgavoth
description: Valgavoth is the elder moth demon who rules Duskmourn, a demon bound in a house who grew to swallow the whole plane and feeds on fear.

summary.text: Valgavoth is the elder moth demon who rules Duskmourn, a demon bound in a house who grew to swallow the whole plane and feeds on fear.

citations.text: "Valgavoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Centuries before the Omenpath Era a previous owner of the House summoned Valgavoth and bound him beneath the basement after he proved too dangerous.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sixteen-year-old Marina Vendrell found him in the cellar and he befriended her to gain freedom, then devoured the bullies she lured to the basement.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Empowered, he hunted, the house expanded and Marina's parents vanished, and when she threatened to burn the house he agreed to restore her world but the house kept growing until it swallowed the plane.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Ascension he expanded the House to encompass the whole plane, gained a psychic connection to it, and killed most of the plane's other demons.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Valgavoth", section "Dominance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: A cult worships him as the Devouring Father, and he drew Tamiyo's echo through a door on Kamigawa, which brought Nashi's search party into the House.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Expansion through Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He offered Winter freedom for four lives and opened a door to Innistrad for him, but Kaito stabbed him through the wall and the rescuers escaped through an artificial Omenpath.

bio.text: Though heavily wounded, he captured Loot and later sent Winter and the Speed Demons to the Ghirapur Grand Prix, then dragged Winter back to Duskmourn when he lost.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Expansion through Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Valgavoth is alive and still rules Duskmourn, and the latest stories still treat him as the demon who rules the rooms of Duskmourn.

citations.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth is given four sacrifices and begins devouring Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: she unwittingly provides the demon Valgavoth with four sacrifices

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's scroll is stolen and taken to Duskmourn, where Valgavoth's cultists strip her shade's memories; Nashi follows her voice and is trapped for three months.
timeline.quote: Nashi followed his mother's voice to the plane, getting trapped for three months before finally locating her.

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot is captured by Valgavoth at Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: he is captured by Valgavoth .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn and rescues the party from Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn by using his mind magic in combination with Kaito’s spark, Aminatou’s abilities, and a piece of wood from the House that Kaito had provided.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft, Etrata and Niv-Mizzet finish securing Ravnica's Omenpaths; Valgavoth begins spying on Proft.
timeline.quote: Valgavoth was able to begin spying on him using the House's doors.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn, and he and Kaito rescue Nashi, the Wanderer, Tyvar, Zimone and Niko from Valgavoth; Niv-Mizzet then releases Proft and Etrata.
timeline.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth captures Loot, who is conscripted onto the Speed Demons and caged by captain Winter atop the Last Ride.
timeline.quote: Although Jace went after his family, the demon Valgavoth captured Loot.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: City reveals a tabard with a moth's wings and invites Dawn to join the Cult of Valgavoth, serving the Devouring Father.
timeline.quote: There's still a place for those of us who wish to serve the Devouring Father, among the Cult of Valgavoth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 1" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In the dream, City looms from the woods, saying the Devouring Father is still hungry.
timeline.quote: The Devouring Father is still hungry

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
timeline.quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The diary reveals that Marina met Valgavoth, a demon summoned and bound in the house by an earlier owner.
timeline.quote: His name is Valgavoth—Val—and he was summoned here and bound by one of the owners before us.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina chooses not to free Valgavoth because he is her only friend.
timeline.quote: Val is the only real friend I've made since we moved here.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: After being bullied, Marina decides to invite her tormentors home and let Valgavoth make them pay.
timeline.quote: I'll invite them over tomorrow after school.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth takes the girls, pulling them into the walls.
timeline.quote: He took them. Hands reached out of the walls and grabbed them

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Marina realizes Valgavoth has become the house and is eating the world around him.
timeline.quote: I think Val is the house, somehow, after all this time

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone concludes Valgavoth has swallowed the outside, leaving no plane beyond the House.
timeline.quote: I think at this point, mathematically speaking, Valgavoth is all.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter explains the cult's belief and that it captures survivors to convert or feed to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: They claim Duskmourn was created by an entity summoned by their ancestors

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The cult leader says Valgavoth can now spread to more worlds merely by knowing they exist.
timeline.quote: He no longer needs to strain with all his might to open a door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 5: Don't Give In" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The head cultist says the captives' knowledge of other worlds will guide the Devouring Father to his next feast.
timeline.quote: Your knowledge will be added to the great list, and with it we will guide the Devouring Father to his next feasting place.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth reveals himself as an enormous moth-demon melded into the wall and the cultists kneel.
timeline.quote: what appeared to be an enormous moth spun from the fabric of nightmares

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth tells Winter he promised his heart's desire in exchange for four lives.
timeline.quote: Four lives to secure your heart's desire. Four thresholds for me to cross.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko deduces that Winter sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: You sacrificed her to a monster for your own heart's desire.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Winter says he gave everything and asks to be let go.
timeline.quote: I gave everything. Now let me go.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth opens a door in his body and promises Winter he may leave; Winter falls as he runs.
timeline.quote: When he folded them again, there was a door set in the base of his body

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer leaps onto the altar and duels the giant moth.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer had leapt up onto the stone altar, and was dueling the massive demon moth

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth roars and cellarspawn and nightmares pour out of the walls.
timeline.quote: cellarspawn and nightmares spilled out of them, pouring into the room.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The door Niko reaches for crumbles to dust.
timeline.quote: the door was gone, falling to dust under Niko's fingers

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth pins the Wanderer and threatens to unmake her world.
timeline.quote: I will swallow everything you are, and I will unmake your world in my own image

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Nashi pulls his mother's scroll from the ghost-trap, and Tamiyo dissolves into moonlight.
timeline.quote: before she dissolved into moonlight and was gone.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito stabs Valgavoth in the chest through the wall with his katana.
timeline.quote: The blade of a katana protruded from it, glistening with ichor and hemolymph

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Wounded Valgavoth survives and pulls a captive orange-furred creature from the attic.
timeline.quote: He reached into the attic above him, wrapping a tendril around a squirming, shivering bundle of orange fur and pulling it down into view.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth takes Winter and melts into the ceiling with him.
timeline.quote: Pulling Winter higher to his leaking, punctured chest, Valgavoth melted into the ceiling

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Smiling hosts in a hillside house read the reader their holy book, and the reader joins the Cult of Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: You belong to the Cult of Valgavoth now.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Following the light to door forty, the reader sees the face of Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: You have seen the face of Valgavoth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Each time Valgavoth sheds his old form, a Harrowing sweeps the House spawning new horrors.
timeline.quote: Whenever Valgavoth sheds his old form, a Harrowing courses through the House

citation.text: Bedevil (Duskmourn: House of Horror Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and the Wanderer stop running from Valgavoth's onslaught.
timeline.quote: Tyvar and the Wanderer were done running.

citation.text: Valgavoth's Onslaught (Duskmourn: House of Horror, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth whispers to Marina until she hears nothing else.
timeline.quote: Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

citation.text: Demonic Counsel (Duskmourn: House of Horror, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath using Kaito's spark and Aminatou's abilities, and Kaito and Proft rescue Nashi and the others from Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn

citation.text: "Aminatou", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth expands his house over Duskmourn in the Ascension and kills most of the plane's other demons.
timeline.quote: One of his first acts after subsuming control of the plane was killing most of the plane's other demons and breaking the rest

citation.text: "Demon", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth, imprisoned in a house, expands its barriers and swallows the entire plane in the Ascension, folding the demon realm into the physical realm.
timeline.quote: expanded the barriers of the House and swallowed the entire plane in a period of chaos known as the Ascension

citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Phyrexians fail to enter the House, possibly blocked by Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , the Phyrexians failed to enter the House.

citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Omenpath Era, doors to other planes become easier for Valgavoth to open, and the House shifts from farming to hunting.
timeline.quote: It can now hunt rather than farm, and the safe zones are rapidly decreasing.

citation.text: "Duskmourn", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth captures Loot.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the demon Valgavoth

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Travels with Loot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn and Kaito and Proft rescue Nashi, the Wanderer, Tyvar, Zimone and Niko from Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: Kaito and Proft then rescued Nashi, the Wanderer, Tyvar, Zimone, and Niko from the grasp of Valgavoth .

citation.text: "Kaito Shizuki", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marina discovers the demon Valgavoth in the basement and befriends him; he teaches her demonology, necromancy and spirit-bending.
timeline.quote: she discovered the demon Valgavoth living in the basement

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After vicious bullying, Marina agrees to Valgavoth's offer and lures her four bullies to the basement, where he devours them.
timeline.quote: she watched, horrified, as the hungry entity came alive and devoured the bullies.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Valgavoth hunts; people around Marina die, the house warps and expands, and her parents vanish.
timeline.quote: But then, her parents vanished.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marina researches and learns that previous owners bound the demon to the house, which she had unwittingly loosened.
timeline.quote: the entity in the basement was a demon

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marina threatens to burn down the house, and Valgavoth agrees to give her back the world as she remembered it, while the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane as Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: the entirety of the plane was swallowed up in the walls of Duskmourn.

citation.text: "Marina Vendrell", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer realizes the cult is siphoning Tamiyo's story echo to feed Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: the cult was using Tamiyo's scroll echo to siphon her stories and feed them to the demon Valgavoth

citation.text: "Nashi", section "Lost on Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth manifests and rewards Winter; the group escapes and Niko discharges their fateshifter.
timeline.quote: Niko was forced to discharge their fateshifter when a cultist stabbed them through the eye.

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth's Ascension transforms Duskmourn into a house and pushes the spirit realm to the plane's edges.
timeline.quote: After Valgavoth 's Ascension and the transformation of Duskmourn into an infinitely large house, that realm was pushed to the edges of the plane.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Winter betrays the party, sealing them in the room with the cultists; they are knocked out and tied up, and the Wanderer learns the cult is feeding Tamiyo's echo to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: Niko, the Wanderer, and Nashi were captured after a betrayal by Winter

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth manifests and opens a door to Innistrad for Winter; Tyvar and Zimone intervene and the group escapes through Kaito's temporary Omenpath.
timeline.quote: which the group used to escape.

citation.text: "The Wanderer", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Tyvar meet Marina Vendrell and find her diary showing she enabled Valgavoth to take over the plane.
timeline.quote: Through her actions, Marina had enabled Valgavoth to grow and consume everything around him

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Zimone rescue Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escape through an Omenpath opened by Kaito.
timeline.quote: Tyvar and Zimone rescued Nashi, Niko, and the Wanderer, who had been captured

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries before the Omenpath Era, Valgavoth is summoned into the mortal realm by a previous owner of the House, who bind him beneath the basement after he proves too dangerous.
timeline.quote: The summoners managed to neutralize him by binding him to the structure of the house where they'd conducted the summoning

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sixteen-year-old Marina Vendrell finds the demon in the cellar, and he befriends her to gain freedom.
timeline.quote: Seeing a path to his freedom, Valgavoth befriended her, helping her to learn demonology, necromancy, and spirit-bending.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marina lures her bullies into the basement and Valgavoth devours them; she realizes her friend is malevolent.
timeline.quote: She watched, horrified, as the hungry entity came alive and devoured the bullies.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Valgavoth hunts; the house expands and Marina's parents vanish.
timeline.quote: But then, her parents vanished.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marina threatens to burn the house down and the demon agrees to restore the world as she remembered it, but the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane.
timeline.quote: The demon grew in power until the entirety of the plane was swallowed up in the walls of Duskmourn.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ascension: Valgavoth expands the House's boundaries to encompass the whole plane and gains a psychic connection to it.
timeline.quote: This event marked his successful expansion of the House's boundaries to encompass the entirety of the plane

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After ascending, Valgavoth kills most of the plane's other demons and breaks the rest.
timeline.quote: One of his first acts after ascending was killing most of the plane's other demons and breaking the rest

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Dominance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth opens a door on Kamigawa and draws in the echo of Tamiyo, prompting Nashi to lead a search party into the House.
timeline.quote: Valgavoth opened a door on Kamigawa and drew in the echo of the former planeswalker Tamiyo

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Expansion through Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Winter leads the Wanderer and Niko Aris into the Cult's trap; Valgavoth manifests and opens a door to Innistrad for Winter.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Winter led the Wanderer and Niko Aris into a trap set by the Cult.
